name: Better Auth
subtitle: Open-source TypeScript auth framework
tagline: Open source, runs in your app
creator: Bereket Engida
maintainer: Better Auth team (acquired by Vercel, Jul 2026)
description: A framework-agnostic authentication library for TypeScript that runs in your own app and stores users in your own database. A plugin system adds features such as two-factor auth, passkeys, organizations and magic links. It took over maintenance of Auth.js in 2025 and is its recommended successor.
useCases: New Next.js, SvelteKit, Nuxt or Hono apps
Teams that want self-owned auth without per-user fees

concepts.explanation: Works with Postgres, MySQL, SQLite, Prisma, Drizzle and Kysely.
createAuthClient() exposes sign-in and session helpers.
Mount the auth routes in your framework.

pros: Plugins cover features that cost extra elsewhere
cons: You run and secure it yourself
Younger project than Auth0 or Keycloak
